name: swarm of poisonous snakes
desc: Swarm of Poisonous Snakes is a CR 2 beast.

actions.name: swarm
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm} can occupy another creature's space and vice versa, and the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm} can move through any opening large enough for a Tiny snake. The swarm can't regain hit points or gain temporary hit points.

actions.name: bites
actions.desc: Melee Weapon Attack: [[/attack]], 0 ft., one creature in the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm}'s space. Hit: [[/damage 2d6 piercing average]] damage, or [[/damage 1d6 piercing average]] damage if the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{swarm} has half of its hit points or fewer. The target must make a [[/save]] saving throw, taking [[/damage average activity=tT3v0krnAO2hA0hs]] damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.
